  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]

  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Handling of empty-collecting modules is fragile and makes the whole heal step exit 1.
  WHY: Transient collection problems in one of the 15 modules abort the step rather than recover. Source severity was MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:1006-1009, 1070-1098 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The claimed time saving is an unmeasured estimate, so the in-place 4-shard split may not bring the job under its 20-minute timeout.
  WHY: If the sharded step still runs over about 17 minutes, the job still times out and CI stays red. Source severity was MAJOR.
